title: Shigmo Festival
description: Goa's prominent spring festival celebrating the arrival of spring with vibrant parades, folk dances, and colorful processions. Traditional folk dances like Ghode Modni and Fugdi are performed during street processions.
location: Various locations in South Goa (Margao, Ponda, Quepem)
date: March/April (Dates vary based on Hindu calendar)
price: Free to attend public events; Special shows: ₹100-500

title: Goa Carnival
description: A grand celebration with parades, music, dance, and colorful floats showcasing Goa's Portuguese heritage. King Momo leads the festival, declaring several days of music, dance, and merry-making.
location: Margao, Vasco, and other South Goa towns
price: Free to attend parades; Food and craft stalls available

title: Sao Joao Festival
description: A monsoon festival where young men jump into wells and waterbodies to retrieve gifts. Celebrated with floral crowns, boat races, and traditional Konkani songs honoring St. John the Baptist.
location: Siolim, Anjuna, Assagao, and coastal villages
price: Free community events; Boat festival entry: ₹100

title: Feast of St. Francis Xavier
description: A significant Christian festival celebrating Goa's patron saint with novenas, masses, and a procession. The saint's preserved body is displayed once every 10 years, but annual celebrations draw thousands of pilgrims.
location: Basilica of Bom Jesus, Old Goa
price: Free to attend; Special masses and events

title: Bonderam Festival
description: A commemoration of protests against Portuguese land policies, featuring flag parades, mock battles with toy weapons, and traditional music. The festivities include 'fotashes' (toy weapon) fights and colorful flag processions.
